title: Digital Democracy Edinburgh: call for proposals and registration now open
content:
Digital Democracy Edinburgh, presented by TICTeC, is an international two-day conference that will take place in Scotland’s capital city on 11 & 12 March 2027.

Policymakers, researchers, civic tech practitioners, public servants, and democratic innovators will come together to explore democratic futures and how digital tools can help make democratic institutions around the world more effective, inclusive and resilient.

We’re delighted to share that registration for the conference is now open, allowing both in-person and online access.

We’ve also just opened up a call for session/presentation proposals, which invites individuals, and groups of contributors, to submit their ideas for the conference proceedings. Read on to learn what we’re looking for in proposals.

Digital Democracy Edinburgh is a collaboration between the Scottish Government, the University of Edinburgh Futures Institute, mySociety, and the AI for Collective Intelligence (AI4CI) Hub.

Digital Democracy Edinburgh is made possible with additional generous support from the Evens Foundation, RadicalxChange and Delib.
